what: Does liquidity in the Pharaoh WAVAX/USDC pool earn any swap fee? Read-only eth_call on api.avax.network, 2026-11-10.
reading: Swaps happened between the two blocks (the gross fee growth moved in both tokens) and the LP fee growth did not move at all. With feeProtocol = 1,000,000 ppm the whole swap fee leaves the pool for the protocol side (voters); liquidity providers are paid in gauge emissions only. LP fee growth is 1.16% (token0) of gross since the pool began, so LPs were paid a share only in an earlier regime; the pinned state at 2026-08-01 already shows 1,000,000.
